text:
elena_pm: Quick sync — need to lock scope for the 'observe surface' initiative: dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, and error analytics. Customers (Acme, Nova) specifically asked for cost-per-route and sample traces. Can we agree on an MLP for Q2?

sam_sre: Short answer: ship dashboards + basic trace sampling first. Full tracing hooks (span tagging + trace linking into UI) is bigger and should be phased.

ajay_eng: Agree with Sam. Rough effort: dashboards ~2 sprints, trace hooks ~3–4 sprints (SDK + instrumentation + rollout), cost breakdown depends on telemetry plumbing.

maria_data: Cost-per-route needs token attribution + per-route aggregation in the pipeline. If we reuse existing telemetry it is ~6 weeks.

kev_design: Don't expand the dashboard surface too much at launch. Proposal: 3 focused dashboards — latency, error-rate, cost-per-request. Can deliver mockups by EOD.

elena_pm: Proposed MLP: (1) dashboards (top-3), (2) sampling trace hooks (1% sample w/ request-id linking), (3) aggregated cost-per-route in UI. Defer full error analytics (root-cause and session replays) to phase 2. Thoughts?

sam_sre: Sounds ok. Add this requirement: automatic rollback if trace hook instrumentation causes >5% request latency increase during canary. Need canary window + opt-out flag.

ajay_eng: Implementation note: SDK will emit a header for tracing and a sampling decision. Pseudo snippet: `// pseudo
if (rand() < sample_rate) { ctx.trace = true; setHeader('X-RW-TRACE','1'); }`

maria_data: For cost per-route we need route metadata at the API edge. Current logs sometimes only have model_id. We'll need a thin change to ensure `route_id` is in the ingest stream.

elena_pm: Draft launch criteria (must-haves): 1) dashboards show 7d and 1h views, 2) trace links open within 2s, 3) cost-per-route numbers within 10% of internal batch calc, 4) rollback & canary plan documented. Anything missing?

kev_design: +1. Add a small UI note: clarify sampling rate and that a sampled trace != full request logs. :thumbsup: 

release-bot: Release checklist created: https://internal/release/12345 — items added for MLP and owners assigned.

ajay_eng: Owners: dashboards -> ajay_eng, trace hooks -> sam_sre + ajay_eng, cost telemetry -> maria_data.

sam_sre: Rollout plan: opt-in beta for ~10 customers, monitor latency SLOs and inference host CPU. Ramp with health gates every 24h.

elena_pm: Ok — I'll convert this to roadmap tickets and mark priority P0 for Q2. Follow-ups: dashboards mockups (kev_design), telemetry API change (ajay_eng + maria_data), canary plan doc (sam_sre).

elena_pm: Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
